name: Tech Mahindra Ltd
note: Listed Indian IT services company; Mahindra & Mahindra's Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 describes it as a listed associate of M&M. Per its own shareholding pattern for the quarter ended 31 December 2025, the promoter & promoter group holds 34.98% and Life Insurance Corporation Of India (state-owned; promoter President of India) holds 11.49%.
